ai_summary: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd. has allotted 94,752 new equity shares under its Employee Stock Option Scheme 2021, resulting in a minor increase in its paid-up share capital by ₹ 4,73,760. This issuance leads to an approximate 0.033% dilution for existing shareholders. This is a routine corporate action for employee incentivization and presents no material adverse impacts or red flags.
